messages:
alice: Getting noisy alerts from ap-sg scrape-manager, lots of EOF/read timeouts and a p95 remote_write latency spike. Grafana SLI shows 5xx for remote_write ingestion too. Anyone on it?
ben: saw that, started digging. Looks region-specific to ap-southeast-1 (singapore). Not global.
cara: I'm on call, tailing sidecar logs now. Seeing repeated: `read tcp 10.42.3.5:42124->10.10.200.17:9090: read: connection reset by peer` and `EOF from remote_write` in sidecar container.
prometheus-bot: alert: PrometheusScrapeErrorsHigh (cluster=ap-sg) firing (3/3).
dmitri: quick check — MTU on the NAT gateway in ap-sg was recently changed during infra upgrade last night. Could be fragmentation + gRPC chunking causing connection resets. MTU mismatch often shows up as intermittent EOF on long push streams.
elaine: interesting, we also rolled out a consul-template relabeler change that adds `pod_affinity_group` label to exporters. Could that explode cardinality? Grafana shows a sharp cardinality growth around the same time.
alice: ok two-fold: network-level EOFs + label cardinality spike. Both could amplify remote_write sizing and timeouts.
ben: confirm from metrics: series_count for node_exporter_* jumped ~6x in ap-sg around 03:12 UTC. remote_write batch size p95 increased, and some exporter payloads hit 413 from cortex/ingest endpoint.
cara: posting relevant log snippet:```
[2026-03-18T03:13:07Z] sidecar warn: write failed: rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted desc = grpc: received message larger than max (3897421 vs 4194304)
[2026-03-18T03:13:09Z] sidecar error: EOF
[2026-03-18T03:13:10Z] prometheus: dropped 1200 samples from job="node-exporter"
```
dmitri: ResourceExhausted + EOF fits fragmentation + oversized batches caused by high cardinality. Short term fixes: reduce `max_samples_per_send`, set `remote_write` send_queue_size lower, and add relabel to drop highly-variable label.
elaine: the consul-template change was supposed to add `pod_affinity_group` but due to a templating bug it appended `pod_affinity_group:{{.PodIPHash}}` when empty, so unique value per pod got injected. Oops. Rolling back is safe.
alice: tentative playbook: 1) rollback consul-template relabel to previous commit 2) patch prometheus scrape config in ap-sg to set `scrape_timeout: 10s` and `metrics_relabel_configs` to drop `pod_affinity_group` 3) reduce `remote_write` `max_samples_per_send` from 5000->1000 and set `queue_config.max_shards` lower 4) restart sidecar pods gradually 5) monitor ingest  
ben: relabel snippet to apply quickly (hotfix):```yaml
relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: ["__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_pod_affinity_group"]
    regex: ".+"
    action: drop
```
cara: rolling the relabel patch now in ap-sg-staging to test. will then apply to prod if green.
dmitri: for MTU: can we short-term set `net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1` on sidecar nodes to avoid black-holing fragmented packets? That reduces need for large MTU until infra team fixes NAT.
elaine: yes sysctl bump is low-risk, will coordinate with infra. Also opening a ticket with cloud provider about NAT MTU drift.
alice: good. adding alert refinement: make PrometheusScrapeErrorsHigh only alert if >5% error with sustained 5m and series_count delta >2x to avoid noisy flaps during short deploys.
prometheus-bot: action: created issue INF-1329 for consul-template relabel rollback and INF-1330 for cloud NAT MTU follow-up.
ben: after rollback and relabel drop, sidecar EOFs dropped within 3 minutes, series_count back to normal in ap-sg. Remote_write 413s stopped. Monitoring for 30m.
cara: patch diff I applied to scrape config:```yaml
- job_name: 'k8s-node-exporter'
  scrape_interval: 30s
  scrape_timeout: 10s
  metrics_relabel_configs:
    - source_labels: ["pod_affinity_group"]
      regex: ".+"
      action: drop
```
dmitri: follow-up: add integration test in CI that validates relabel template doesn't inject pod-unique hashes. Prevents regressions.
elaine: agreed. Also adding runbook step to detect sudden per-job series_count multipliers and auto-mute the relabel template rollout in consul when spike > 3x.
alice: thanks all. marking incident as mitigated but keeping thread open for postmortem items. 
prometheus-bot: resolved: PrometheusScrapeErrorsHigh (cluster=ap-sg) - firing -> resolved at 2287654387
ben: will draft short postmortem, include timeline and mitigation steps.
cara: leaving a note: set `remote_write` `max_samples_per_send` default to 1500 in our Helm chart so single exporter can't blow payloads.
alice: nice. closing in 1h unless new alerts. :thumbsup:
